scientific_limitations: The objective is stationary interfacial entropy production only; it excludes diffusion bulk entropy and entropy attributed to resetting.
The optimum is unique only if the baseline endpoint densities differ. Boundary-balanced resetting gives zero interfacial contribution for all permeabilities.
The interface obeys symmetric constant permeability, drift-free homogeneous diffusion, and Poisson resetting to a fixed law.
The stationary equations and qualitative permeability nonmonotonicity are established prior work. The claimed contribution is a sharp global optimization theorem and associated bounds.
Numerical tests supplement exact analysis; no independent verification or audit has been performed.
title: Unique optimal membrane permeability and sharp universal bounds for resetting diffusion on a ring
